title: PseuDRAGON: Knowledge-Guided Local LLMs for Financial-Data Pseudonymization in Closed Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.30353v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Staff pseudonymizing financial data in closed networks must interpret abbreviated column names, identify personal information, and choose processing methods. Local language models can assist, but may give different labels for the same input. PseuDRAGON keeps confirmed judgments and corrections outside a fixed model and reuses them through exact-name lookup and learned rules. For expert review, the workflow searches institutional policy, national privacy law, then international sources. Across 92 columns from one institution, rules increase reuse under the same approval checks from 75 to 83 labels without reuse errors when all training judgments are available. With 25% of the training judgments, withholding non-PII rules for unseen names eliminated the extra PII misses in replay at the cost of lower reuse. Revising or withdrawing approvals rebuilds derived rules, and tests on synthetic records verify that selected methods produce the spec

translated_title: PseuDRAGON：面向封闭网络中金融数据假名化的知识引导本地大语言模型
translated_abstract: 在封闭网络中对金融数据进行假名化处理的工作人员必须解读缩写的列名、识别个人信息（PII），并选择合适的处理方法。本地语言模型可以提供帮助，但可能对相同输入给出不一致的标签。PseuDRAGON 将已确认的判断和修正保存在固定模型之外，并通过精确名称查找和习得的规则来复用它们。在专家审查环节，该工作流程依次检索机构政策、国家隐私法律，然后是国际来源。在来自一个机构的 92 个列上，当所有训练判断可用时，规则在相同审批检查下将可复用的标签数从 75 个提升到 83 个，且没有复用错误；当仅有 25% 的训练判断时，对未见过的名称不保留非 PII 规则的做法消除了重放中的额外 PII 遗漏，代价是复用率降低。修改或撤回审批会触发派生规则的重建，并且在合成记录上的测试验证了所选方法能够产生符合规范的结果。
tldr: PseuDRAGON 通过在固定模型外保存并复用已确认的判断与修正（精确名称查找加习得规则），提升了封闭网络中金融数据假名化的一致性、减少了个人信息遗漏，并支持审批变更后的规则重建。
en_tdlr: PseuDRAGON improves consistency and reduces PII misses in closed-network financial data pseudonymization by storing confirmed judgments outside the local LLM and reusing them via exact-name lookup and learned rules, while rebuilding derived rules when approvals are revised or withdrawn.
